messages:
lee.support: heads up — Trial account SprocketCo is causing an ingest surge since 09:10 UTC. We're seeing 429s and a few timeouts. Applied a soft throttle to protect cluster. Escalating to CS for comms and renewal risk.

nina.csm: thanks lee. quick check: is this quota or parallel hammering? i'll offer a short enablement session and a temporary uplift if infra can approve.

infra-bot: alert: rate_limit_triggered customer=sprocket-42 policy=ingest-default window=60s spike_factor=3

ravi.eng: logs show many concurrent small requests (parallel curl per file) causing cache pressure. not a service outage. we can grant a one-time "fastpass" +30% quota for 90m with infra signoff. recommend sharing batching guidance. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/ingest-throttle

sam.csops: drafting comms: short apology + action, options: (A) 30m enablement office hours, (B) temporary +30% fastpass 90m while they run backfill with batching. include sample xargs snippet and Calendly link.

nina.csm: suggested reply: "Hi — we've applied temporary protection to keep your trial healthy. Options: A) 30m enablement to optimize batching, or B) request a one-time +30% fastpass for 90m while you run the backfill. Reply A or B and we'll take care of it. —Nina"

lee.support: customer confirms they kicked off a parallel uploader script. sent their snippet.

ravi.eng: recommended pattern to share: ```xargs -P4 -n1 -I{} curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -d @{} < <(printf "%s\n" files/*)``` and advise batching 25-50 docs per request.

sam.csops: pasted email template and the sample script into thread. ops request created for fastpass id=fp-99012 requester=nina.csm amount=30% duration=90m status=pending

ravi.eng: i'll watch metrics for 2 hours and rollback the fastpass if errors rise. setting alert threshold at >5% errors.

nina.csm: actions: sam send email once template approved (pending), infra approve fastpass (pending), lee follow up w/ customer for A/B choice (in progress), ravi monitor. marking P1 for cs given trial/renewal risk. will update when they reply. :eyes:
